retention.title: Data & retention
retention.subtitle: What Atlas keeps for your academy, what it removes after a long period without a subscription, and exactly when.

noOrganization.title: No organization yet
noOrganization.description: Retention applies to an organization's hosted video. Create your organization and anything you upload will be listed here.

empty.title: You have no hosted video
empty.description: Retention only ever removes hosted video. You haven't uploaded any, so there is nothing for it to act on. Your courses, students, certificates and site are kept regardless.

error.title: We couldn't load your retention status
error.description: Nothing has changed and nothing has been deleted — we just couldn't read your current status. Try again.

summary.someRemoved_one: One hosted video has been removed after a long period without a subscription.
summary.someRemoved_other: {{count}} hosted videos have been removed after a long period without a subscription.
summary.scheduled: Your hosted video is scheduled to be deleted on {{date}}.
summary.notEnabled: Automatic deletion is not switched on, so nothing is scheduled. If it were, the date would be {{date}}.
summary.held: Your retention countdown is paused, so no deletion is scheduled right now.

retention.modeOff: Automatic deletion is not switched on for Atlas at the moment. The dates below show what would apply if it were — nothing is going to happen on them today.

not_scheduled.title: Your hosted video is safe
not_scheduled.description: No retention window is open for your organization. Hosted video is only ever removed after a long, continuous period without a subscription — and never your courses, students, certificates or website.

scheduled.title: A retention window is open
scheduled.description: Your subscription has been inactive long enough to start the {{days}}-day retention clock. You will receive four notices before anything is removed, and subscribing again at any point stops it completely.

warning.title: Your hosted video is due to be deleted
warning.description: We have written to you about this. Your video is still here, and subscribing again before {{date}} stops the deletion completely.

held.title: Your retention countdown is paused
held.description: Your retention clock is on hold, so nothing will be removed while it stays that way. We will write to you again if it resumes.

elapsed.title: The retention date has passed
elapsed.description: The date set for removing your hosted video has passed. Subscribing again is still the fastest way to restore normal service; contact support if you would like this reviewed.

origin.trial: 90 days, because this organization was last on a free trial
origin.paid: 180 days, because this organization was last on a paid plan

timeline.title: What happens, and when
timeline.description: You receive four notices before any hosted video is removed. Subscribing again at any stage stops the sequence.

courses.title: Courses that would be affected
courses.description: These courses contain the hosted video in question. The courses themselves, and everything else in them, are kept.
courses.caption: Courses containing hosted video subject to retention

keep.title: How to keep your video
keep.description: Subscribe again. That ends the retention window immediately, stops the notices, and nothing is removed.
keep.kept: Whatever happens, Atlas keeps your academies, courses, curriculum, students, enrolments, progress, certificates, orders and your public website. Only hosted video files are ever removed, and lessons then show that the video was removed rather than a broken player.
keep.support: If you need more time, contact support before the date above and we can put your account on hold.

gift.firstSubscriptionNote: Gifted on your first paid subscription. Your paid period starts when the gifted days end, so you still get the full period you paid for.
gift.offer_one: Your first paid subscription includes 1 gifted setup day
gift.offer_other: Your first paid subscription includes {{count}} gifted setup days
gift.offerNote: Added before your paid period starts, once your payment is confirmed.
